title: apium lingula
intro: Apium lingula, commonly known as Water Celery or Wild Celery, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Apiaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Apium lingula include diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis, kidney stones, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Apium lingula include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
